policy.purpose: Primary and authoritative source anchors for original question generation, currentness audits and rights audits.
policy.default: Use verified facts to create original wording. Do not reproduce third-party CQ/Answer, figures, algorithms, tables, question text or images unless an explicit reusable-rights basis is recorded.
policy.medicalRule: Clinical assertions require a current authoritative source and sourceCheckedAt. If a source is superseded, affected production questions lose PASS status until revalidated.
policy.rightsRule: Clinical guidance can be used as a verification anchor without copying protected expression. A source marked directReproduction=no must never be copied into production content without separately recorded permission.
